//: Nightly maintenance service — audit chain verification, pg_dump backup,
idempotency cleanup, daily digests.
This file exists because none of that was running. app/tasks/nightly.py
was written, orchestrates all four jobs in order, and exits non-zero on
failure — but nothing anywhere scheduled it. infra/railway.json defines
the API service only and carries no cron block, no workflow invoked it,
and docs/RUNBOOK.md nonetheless described a 'Railway cron' running daily
at 02:00 SLT. So the audit chain was never verified, no backup was ever
taken, and no digest was ever sent.
Railway models a cron as its own service with the same image and a
cronSchedule, so this is deployed as a SECOND service pointed at this
file rather than merged into railway.json.
Deploy:  railway up --config infra/railway.cron.json
It needs DATABASE_URL_MIGRATOR set (the migrator role owns the schema;
app_user's DML-only grants are not sufficient for a complete pg_dump),
and the image must carry postgresql-client — which infra/Dockerfile.api
did not install until this same pass, so the backup task could only ever
have failed with 'pg_dump not found'.
02:00 Asia/Colombo is 20:30 UTC the previous day (UTC+5:30). Railway
cron schedules are UTC, so this is 30 20 * * *, not 0 2 * * *.
